lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Sorry, I'm yawning. I just finished a twelve-hour shift, ka.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: I'm a night-shift ER nurse. Somebody has to be awake at 3am, na?

choices.text: That's amazing. You save lives every night.

reply.speaker: arisa
reply.text: Hehe, mostly I clean up and hold hands. But thank you, ka.

choices.text: Doesn't that mess up your sleep?

reply.speaker: arisa
reply.text: Jing jing. I sleep like a vampire now.
reply.translation: Seriously. I sleep like a vampire now.

choices.text: So you just give people shots?

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: After my shift I always stop at Night Owl Mart. Ham and cheese toastie. Best 3am food, ka.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Then I feed the stray cats by my apartment. Every night. They wait for me now.

reply.speaker: arisa
reply.text: I think I'm the lucky one, na.

choices.text: How many cats are we talking?

reply.speaker: arisa
reply.text: Seven. Maybe eight. They don't tell me their names.

choices.text: Isn't feeding strays a bad idea?

reply.speaker: arisa
reply.text: Hmm. Okay, ka. I'll still feed them.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Can I tell you something embarrassing? I watch old lakorn dramas to relax.
lines.translation: Can I tell you something embarrassing? I watch old Thai soap operas (lakorn) to relax.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Slaps, amnesia, evil twins. I love all of it, ka.

choices.text: Evil twins? I'm in. Show me one.

reply.speaker: arisa
reply.text: Really? Okay! You have to promise to finish it, na.

reply.speaker: arisa
reply.text: Like soap operas, but more slapping.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Every morning — well, my morning — I need Thai milk tea. Extra sweet, ka.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Extra extra sweet. Don't judge me, na.

choices.text: Extra sweet is the only correct way.
I'm more of a coffee person.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: You know what I really can't stand? People who rush.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: At work, everybody rushes. Outside work, I want slow. Slow is good, na.

choices.text: Hard to avoid in an ER, I bet.

reply.speaker: arisa
reply.text: Very hard. That's why I rush there and nowhere else.

choices.text: Hurry up and finish the story then.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: I'm 25, ka. Old enough to be tired all the time.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: My birthday is August 12. I'm a Leo, na. Quiet Leo.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: I'm 5'4". Everyone thinks I'm shorter. I don't know why.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Mango sticky rice is my favorite food. Forever. I'd eat it every day if I could.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Soft pink. My scrubs are blue, so everything else I own is pink, ka.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Songkran is the best holiday. The whole country has a water fight for three days, na.
lines.translation: Songkran (Thai New Year) is the best holiday. The whole country has a water fight for three days.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: I listen to Thai pop. And old luk thung my mom used to play. It makes me homesick in a good way.
lines.translation: I listen to Thai pop. And old luk thung (Thai country music) my mom used to play. It makes me homesick in a good way.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: Nine is my lucky number. In Thai it sounds like 'moving forward', ka.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: My ideal date? Quiet breakfast after my night shift. Then a nap. Together. Hehe.

lines.speaker: arisa
lines.text: When I'm close to someone older, I call them phi. Maybe I'll call you that one day, na.
lines.translation: When I'm close to someone older, I call them phi (big brother/sister). Maybe I'll call you that one day.
